description: Forces this MCP server to re-authenticate: it re-exchanges its configured user key (MCP_AUTH_USER_KEY) for a fresh session token and reports the userId and expiry. Takes no parameters or credentials. Auth is automatic: call this only to force a re-login or after a 401, never in a loop. If the server holds no credential of its own (none configured, or you sent your own Bearer token) it returns an error naming MCP_AUTH_USER_KEY.
name: session_login
